name: PD-E2: double Profile tap stays drawer

steps.name: Reach Profile drawer via Home Profile
Tap Get started on language screen
Check title is English 'Welcome to L2B'
Tap Get started on onboarding slide 2
Read Get OTP enabled on the clickable outer View
Press digit keys without replacing the field
Check Quick Booking title and Close are visible
Check Quick Booking title and Close are visible
Check Quick Booking title and Close are visible
Tap Close (clickable outer View, not the inner icon)
Check Quick Booking title and Close are visible
Check Request to extend time dialog
Check Quick Booking title and Close are visible
Check Home identity (greeting or Current Earning, not Quick Booking app bar)
Check rental Home stat cards from 21 Sep dump
Tap clickable node with content-desc, or clickable outer wrapping it
Check Profile drawer identity (Account + Log Out)
Check Request to extend time dialog
Check Quick Booking title and Close are visible
Tap clickable node with content-desc, or clickable outer wrapping it
